params.name: start_time
params.description: Restrict results to rides starting after this point in time. The value should be in ISO 8601 format.

params.name: end_time
params.description: Restrict results to rides starting before this point in time. The value should be in ISO 8601 format.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rides to return. Default is 10.

items.docs: Returns a list of past and current rides for the authenticated user. Results can be filtered by start and end time.
Requests a new Lyft ride on behalf of the authenticated user. The request must include a ride type and origin location. A destination may optionally be specified at the time of request.
